versions.name: Akela's World Cub Scout Camp

features.note: A shower house in the campsite area with separate facilities for men, women, and youth.
An indoor climbing wall at Hanna Venture Base, a short drive from camp.
Khan's Kabin, a makerspace for art and craft projects.
A staffed health office in the Mark Program Center.
The Arrow of Light Outpost camps away from the main camp.
A picnic shelter in each village.
Includes three-person slingshots at the Lost Ship.
The Treehouses science area, with engineering and forensics adventures.
Huck Finn's Waterfront on the spring-fed Crystal Lake; the camp has no pool.

versions.summary: Cub Scout weekend resident camp at Crystal Lake Scout Reservation near Rhinelander, Wisconsin, operated by Samoset Council for Cub Scout packs with high-energy activities.

sources.citation: Community correction via Camp Finder Suggest-a-Correction form; submitted by the camp director 2026-08-13 (submission yXoKORd), kept anonymous at submitter request. Director gives the exact address as 5231 Crystal Lake Rd, Rhinelander WI 54501 (across the lake from Tesomas); the prior point was an approximate placement. Coordinates cleared pending re-geocoding from the corrected address.
Coordinate geocoded 2026-08-14 from the corrected street address via the US Census geocoder; elevation from the open-meteo DEM. July normals still pending a WorldClim resample.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence).
